correctness.rationale: For centered equal-variance Gaussian eps_j, Var(eps2-2eps1+eps0)=0 forces eps1=(eps0+eps2)/2 and equal variances then all three common, with nonzero deterministic denominator. Otherwise D has smooth positive density at zero. Conditional Gaussian second moment E[X^2|D=0]=s^2+(mX-c*mD/vD)^2 cannot vanish: if it did, X=(mX/mD)D almost surely, implying eps2=(1+r)eps1-r eps0; equal variances force Cov(eps0,eps1)=sigma^2, hence common noise, contradiction. Gaussian conditional integrability yields t-tail f_D(0) E[X^2|D=0] symmetrically for X^2/D, while Gaussian Z0 is light-tailed. Exact tail integration proves the p<1 threshold and 4K capped loss; covariance calculation yields the equicorrelation coefficient. Independent 300 PSD Gaussian covariance designs gave positive K; continuous-law proof does not rely on numerical sampling.
